# Steno Start

> Learn steno basics on your phone. A guided, offline introduction to stenography. Learn the 22-key steno keyboard one chord at a time, then practise real sentences. Free to try, one payment for Pro.

## Canonical facts

- App: Steno Start
- URL: https://stenostart.uk/
- Platforms: Android, iOS (store listings being prepared)
- Price: free to try; one-off in-app purchase for Pro; no subscription
- Account required: no
- Advertising and analytics: none
- Works offline: yes; lessons, sentences and progress stay on the device
- Independent: not affiliated with Plover or Open Steno
- Open dictionary: Steno Start Open Dictionary, 500 words, CC BY-SA 4.0
- Dictionary source: https://github.com/thebillington/steno-start-open-dict
- Support: https://github.com/sponsors/thebillington

## Pages

- [Steno Start](https://stenostart.uk/): what the app teaches, how it works and pricing.
- [Open dictionary](https://stenostart.uk/dictionary/): the 500-word CC BY-SA 4.0 teaching dictionary, its provenance and download links.
- [Support](https://stenostart.uk/support/): contact and troubleshooting.
- [Privacy](https://stenostart.uk/privacy/) and [terms](https://stenostart.uk/terms/): data handling and licence terms.

## Positioning

Steno Start is a guided introduction to the 22-key steno keyboard on a phone or tablet. It is a learning aid, not a system keyboard and not a full professional steno course. It teaches a 500-word beginner dictionary and can import a Plover-style JSON dictionary in Pro.
